title: Sloth waving hello
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x="10" y="62" width="80" height="8" rx="4" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="10" y="62" width="80" height="4" rx="2" fill="#A0714F"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="52" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#9B8866"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="54" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#B3A084"/>
  <!-- left leg hanging -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="68" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#8A7758"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="76" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#D4C9A8"/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="68" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#8A7758"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="76" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#D4C9A8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="34" rx="17" ry="15" fill="#B3A084"/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="36" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#E8DFC0"/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="33" rx="5" ry="4.5" fill="#6B5A3E"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="33" rx="5" ry="4.5" fill="#6B5A3E"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="33" r="2.5" fill="#FFE87C"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="33" r="2.5" fill="#FFE87C"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="33" r="1.2" fill="#3A2E1A"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="33" r="1.2" fill="#3A2E1A"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="39" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#5C4A32"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M43 42 Q48 47 53 42" stroke="#5C4A32" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving right arm -->
  <path d="M64 46 Q74 38 72 26" stroke="#9B8866" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="24" r="5" fill="#B3A084"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="20" r="2.2" fill="#D4C9A8"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="19.5" r="2.2" fill="#D4C9A8"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="22" r="2.2" fill="#D4C9A8"/>
  <!-- left arm gripping branch -->
  <path d="M32 46 Q24 54 26 62" stroke="#9B8866" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="63" r="5" fill="#B3A084"/>
  <!-- claw hooks on branch -->
  <path d="M23 66 L23 70" stroke="#D4C9A8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M27 66 L27 70" stroke="#D4C9A8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
